entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신‧수유기, 병중‧병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used for the supply of vitamin B₁ in cases of physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, and reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), for the relief of neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain (back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), and for beriberi, eye fatigue, and the supply of selenium.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신ㆍ수유기, 병중ㆍ병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used for the supply of vitamins A, D, E, B1, B2, B6, and C in cases of physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), the growth period, and old age, for the relief of dry eyes, for the prevention of night blindness (difficulty seeing at night), poor development of the bones and teeth, and rickets, for the prevention and treatment of iron deficiency anemia, and for the supply of zinc.

This medicine is used for the supply of vitamins B2, B6, and C in cases of physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, and reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), and for the relief of angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation of the inside of the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis.
entries.이 약은 인후, 구강, 잇몸, 발치 전후의 염증치료 및 진통에 사용합니다: This medicine is used for the treatment of inflammation and the relief of pain in the throat, the oral cavity, and the gums, and before and after tooth extraction.
entries.이 약은 자양강장, 허약체질, 육체피로, 병중병후, 위장장애, 영양장애,: This medicine is used for nutritional supplementation in cases such as nourishing and strengthening the body, a weak constitution, physical fatigue, during or after illness, gastrointestinal disorders, nutritional disorders, febrile wasting diseases, and pregnancy and lactation.
entries.이 약은 정신적·신체적 기능무력 증상과 회복기간(아미노산 결핍상태) 동안: This medicine is used as adjunctive therapy for symptoms of mental and physical asthenia and during the recovery period (a state of amino acid deficiency).
This medicine is used for drowsiness and for recovery from fatigue.
entries.이 약은 치열, 치핵의 아픔, 가려움, 부종(부기), 출혈의 일시적 완화: This medicine is used for the temporary relief and disinfection of the pain, itching, edema (swelling), and bleeding of anal fissures and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 치질로 인한 불쾌감, 작열감, 가려움의 일시적 완화에 사용합니다: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of the discomfort, burning sensation, and itching caused by hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후통, 기침, 가래, 오한, 발열,: This medicine is used for the relief of the various symptoms of the common cold, such as runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills, fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 허약체질, 피로회복, 과로, 자한(정신이 멀쩡하고 움직이지도 않: This medicine is used for a weak constitution, recovery from fatigue, overwork, spontaneous sweating (sweating by itself even though the person is fully alert and has not been moving), and during or after illness.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 수두 또는 인플루엔자에 감염되어 있거나 또는 의심: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the following apply: an infant or a child under 15 years of age who has, or is suspected of having, chickenpox or influenza; a person with an allergic constitution; a person who has experienced allergic reactions (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.); a person with liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, gastroduodenal ulcer, glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), or difficulty urinating; an elderly person; a person in poor physical condition or a person with a high fever; a person whose gastrointestinal problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain persist or recur, or who has ulcers or bleeding problems; a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant; a breastfeeding woman; a person under treatment by a doctor or dentist (a person who is being given other medicines such as diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids); or a patient with a cough (smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that persists or recurs for 1 week or more, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash, or a persistent headache). Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When administering it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur while taking it, so take care when driving or operating machinery. In patients given barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol, the ability to metabolize large amounts of acetaminophen is reduced, which may increase the plasma half-life of acetaminophen, so take care.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 ACE 저해제, 리튬, 푸로세미드 및 티아자이드계: While taking this medicine, do not take ACE inhibitors, lithium, furosemide and thiazide diuretics, high-dose methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (warfarin, etc.), selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, other sleep aids, hypnotic sedatives, MAO inhibitors, cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, or other medicines containing ibuprofen or diphenhydramine. Do not take it together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Before taking this medicine, people who take low-dose aspirin to prevent myocardial infarction or stroke should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 다른 해열진통제, 감기약, 진정제를 복용하지 마십: While taking this medicine, do not take other antipyretic analgesics, cold medicines, or sedatives. Before taking this medicine, people who are given other medicines such as diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids and people who take low-dose aspirin to prevent myocardial infarction or stroke should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제,: While taking this medicine, do not take antitussives and expectorants, other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, antihistamines, or preparations containing diphenhydramine together with it. Before taking this medicine, people who are being given diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants and alcohol, or flucloxacillin should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 눈의 통증이 심한 사람, 안약에 의한 알레르기 증: Before using this medicine, people with severe eye pain, people who have experienced allergic symptoms from eye drops (e.g. redness of the eyes, itching, swelling, rash, congestion causing reddening, etc.), and patients with glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Use this medicine for ophthalmic instillation only. Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelids or eyelashes, and do not use it if it is cloudy. Do not share it with other people. If there is no improvement in symptoms even after using it for several days, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 심한 눈의 통증, 안약에 의한 알레르기 증상(예를: Before using this medicine, people with severe eye pain, people who have experienced allergic symptoms from eye drops (for example, redness of the eyes, itching, edema (swelling), rash, congestion causing reddening, etc.), and patients with glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When it is used in children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for ophthalmic instillation only. Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses. If the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy (clouded) because of eye discharge or mold, so take care, and do not use it if it has become cloudy (clouded). To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible. Do not administer it beyond its expiry date, and once it has been opened, use it as soon as possible. If crystals of the ingredients adhere in red around the dropper opening of the container and on the inside of the cap, wipe them off gently with clean gauze before use.
entries.이 약을 사용하는 동안 dl-메틸에페드린염산염, 스코폴리아 엑스 및 글리: While using this medicine, do not take (use) dl-methylephedrine hydrochloride, scopolia extract, or suppositories, ointments, or creams containing glycyrrhizic acid, antihypertensives, or antidepressants.
entries.이상증상이나 알레르기 반응이 나타날 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If abnormal symptoms or allergic reactions occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제, 레보도파와 함게: Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. When it is given together with antialdosterone agents or triamterene, it may cause hyperkalemia, so take care. Avoid teas containing tannin such as green tea and black tea while taking it and before and after taking it.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제, 레보도파와 함께: Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. If it is taken together with antialdosterone agents, triamterene, or cardiac glycosides, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Avoid teas containing tannin such as green tea and black tea while taking it and before and after taking it.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 항생제, 제산제와 함께 복용하지: Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. If it is taken together with antialdosterone agents or triamterene, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Avoid teas containing tannin such as green tea and black tea, and milk and dairy products, while taking it and before and after taking it.
entries.자극 또는 민감성 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약: If irritation or sensitivity occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Rarely, a burning sensation (a hot feeling), stinging wounds, a feeling of dryness, erythema (red spots), itching, or local irritation may occur.
entries.전염성농가진, 모낭염 등과 같은 세균성 및 바이러스성 감염증이 나타나는: If bacterial or viral infections such as impetigo contagiosa or folliculitis occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a persistent feeling of irritation, rash or redness with congestion, flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, heat rash, worsening of wounds, bedsores, pustulosis, ringworm such as athlete's foot or tinea, acne, or festering occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When it is used on the skin of the eyelids, it may cause increased intraocular pressure, glaucoma, or blurred vision, so take care.
entries.제산제와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.우유 섭취 후 1시간 이내에 이 약을 복: Do not take this medicine together with antacids. Do not take this medicine within 1 hour after consuming milk.
entries.증상이 악화되거나 72시간 이상 지속되는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사: If the symptoms worsen or persist for 72 hours or more, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. To avoid contaminating this medicine, do not let the tip of the container touch anything outside. Do not use it if the color of the solution has changed or it has become cloudy (turbid, clouded). Do not reuse it after a single use, and be sure to discard any remaining solution and the container. If you accidentally take this medicine by mouth, get help from a professional immediately.
entries.진해(기침을 그치게 함)거담제(가래약), 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정: Do not take this medicine together with antitussives (which stop coughing) and expectorants (phlegm medicines), other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis (nasal inflammation), motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). If it is taken together with diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol, potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, etacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide), consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.질환 부위가 곪아 있는 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하: Patients whose diseased area is festering must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When administering it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine only on the anal area; do not use it for ophthalmic purposes.
entries.충혈되어 붉어짐, 부종(부기), 자극감, 알레르기 증상(발진, 충혈되어: If congestion causing reddening, edema (swelling), a feeling of irritation, allergic symptoms (rash, congestion causing reddening, itching, etc.), or bleeding occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.클로르헥시딘에 과민증 경험자, 뇌, 척수, 눈, 귀(내이, 중이, 외이): People who have experienced hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on the brain, spinal cord, eyes, ears (inner ear, middle ear, outer ear), or mucous membranes (especially genital mucous membranes), or in infants aged 2 months or younger. Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to other medicines, patients with or with a history of allergic reactions such as asthma, and those applying it to large areas of broken skin (especially burns), mucous membranes, or immature skin should consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine is for external use only; do not take it orally or inject it. Take care that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse them out thoroughly with clean water immediately. Do not use it to disinfect surgical instruments. Take the alcohol content into account. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. This medicine is adsorbed by fabrics and cloths (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon, etc.), so when it is used by soaking them in the solution, supply fresh solution if the effective concentration is not maintained. It is a flammable liquid, so take care. Dry it before using electrical appliances.
entries.투석요법을 받고 있는 환자, 만 7세 이하의 어린이, 갈락토오스 불내성,: Patients receiving dialysis therapy, children aged 7 years or younger, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people with kidney disorder, people with an allergic constitution, and people on a sodium-restricted diet should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When administering it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.피부에 발진, 발적, 가려움 등이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 사용을 즉각 중: If rash, redness, or itching appears on the skin, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Benzoic acid (sodium benzoate) may cause mild irritation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes.
entries.피부의 세균성(전염성 농가진, 모낭염 등), 바이러스성 감염증, 모낭염,: If bacterial skin infections (impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, etc.), viral infections, folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, itching, rash and redness, flushing, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, heat rash, worsening of wounds, bedsores, pustulosis, hypersensitivity, skin discoloration, hirsutism, acneiform eruptions, hypopigmentation, perioral dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, skin maceration, secondary infection, skin atrophy, striae, increased intraocular pressure, or glaucoma occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.필요 시 각각의 눈에 1회 1방울씩, 1일 수회 점안합니다.아래 눈꺼풀을: If necessary, instill 1 drop into each eye at a time, several times a day. Gently pull the lower eyelid down and, while looking up, instill one drop into the lower conjunctival sac. After instillation, discard any remaining solution and the container.
entries.항정신병약과 수면제(최면효과를 증가시킬 수 있습니다)와 함께 복용하지 마: Do not take this medicine together with antipsychotics or sleeping pills (they may increase the hypnotic effect).
Do not use this medicine together with antihypertensives or antidepressants.
